gloss: small trick; clever technique; minor skill

definitions.gloss: small trick; clever technique; handy tip
definitions.explanation: A minor but useful technique or trick, often referring to a clever shortcut or practical tip in daily life, technology, or work.

definitions.gloss: minor technique (in martial arts or sports)
definitions.explanation: A small-scale technique in martial arts, sumo, or other sports, as opposed to a major or decisive technique.

examples.japanese: {便利|べんり}な{小技|こわざ}を{紹介|しょうかい}する。
このアプリには{知|し}っておくと{役|やく}に{立|た}つ{小技|こわざ}がたくさんある。
examples.english: This app has lots of little tricks that are useful to know.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}の{小技|こわざ}を{覚|おぼ}えると、{毎日|まいにち}の{食事|しょくじ}{作|づく}りがずっと{楽|らく}になる。
examples.english: Once you learn a few cooking tricks, preparing daily meals becomes much easier.

examples.japanese: {小技|こわざ}で{一本|いっぽん}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: To score a point with a minor technique.

examples.japanese: {大技|おおわざ}ではなく{小技|こわざ}を{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねて{勝|か}った。
examples.english: He won by piling up minor techniques rather than major ones.

examples.japanese: {相撲|すもう}では{体|からだ}の{小|ちい}さい{力士|りきし}ほど{小技|こわざ}を{使|つか}いこなす{傾向|けいこう}がある。
examples.english: In sumo, smaller wrestlers tend to be adept at using minor techniques.

notes:
A compound of {小|こ} (small) and {技|わざ} (technique, skill). In modern usage, sense 1 (handy tips and tricks) is extremely common, especially in technology and lifestyle contexts — articles titled 「{便利|べんり}な{小技|こわざ}○{選|せん}」 (X useful tricks) are ubiquitous online.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {便利|べんり}な{小技|こわざ}: handy trick
- {小技|こわざ}を{使|つか}う: to use a minor technique
- {小技|こわざ}を{効|き}かせる: to employ a clever touch
- {小技|こわざ}{集|しゅう}: collection of tips and tricks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大技|おおわざ}: major technique — the opposite; a big, decisive move
- コツ: knack, trick — more informal, refers to the key point of doing something well
- {裏|うら}ワザ: hidden trick, secret technique — implies something not widely known
